note: Closure criteria for prior D1+D2 findings; statuses and verdicts removed.

findings.title: Contract route and permission ceilings do not constrain leases

closure_check.method: Run TestAuditorD12RouteCeiling with the out-of-contract route.
closure_check.expected: Derivation refuses; an in-ceiling route still succeeds.

closure_check.method: Present a route with bounded_write against a read_only contract and vary approved route identity while preserving the plan.
closure_check.expected: Both permission broadening and identity mismatch refuse before a lease becomes active.

findings.title: Dependency correction does not invalidate dependent leases

closure_check.method: Run dependency_correction, dependency_route_rewind and unrelated_correction controls.
closure_check.expected: Direct and transitive dependents refuse; unrelated unit stays active.

closure_check.method: Approve a new legal issuing transition for an invalidated dependent.
closure_check.expected: Only that new generation can resume; old generation never revives.

findings.title: Lease wall time starts at record append instead of human approval

closure_check.method: Run the real Apply late-approval test with a one-minute plan and two-minute-old approval.
closure_check.expected: Transition may remain otherwise legal, but derivation refuses expired lease.

closure_check.method: Test one nanosecond before expiry, exact expiry, and Now before approval.
closure_check.expected: Only the request inside [approval, expiry) succeeds.

findings.title: Unicode decoding loses document content before hashing

closure_check.method: Run invalid_utf8, invalid_utf8_second, lone_surrogate and other_lone_surrogate tests for contracts and plans.
closure_check.expected: Each malformed input is rejected before any digest is returned.

closure_check.method: Round-trip valid non-ASCII text, valid paired surrogates and explicit U+FFFD.
closure_check.expected: Valid scalar Unicode survives and material statement/check changes change the digest.

findings.title: Plan validation accepts units missing required bounded-work fields

closure_check.method: Delete one required field at a time from an otherwise complete unit and run ParsePlan and DeriveLease.
closure_check.expected: Each missing declaration is rejected; explicit empty lists only pass where the documented schema permits them.

closure_check.method: Present an explicit complete unit with all required declarations.
closure_check.expected: Parsing and derivation continue to succeed.

findings.title: Lease derivation ignores current core criterion ID drift

closure_check.method: Run the fresh-approval criterion mismatch reproduction; test renamed, missing, extra and duplicate IDs.
closure_check.expected: Each mismatch refuses a lease.

closure_check.method: Change only a criterion disposition while preserving exact IDs.
closure_check.expected: The ID-set check remains satisfied; separate disposition policy still applies.

findings.title: Initial acceptance can silently drop a presented contract

closure_check.method: Run ApplyDropsPresentedContract and a both-absent legacy control.
closure_check.expected: Presented-unbound contract refuses; legacy transition still succeeds.

closure_check.method: Run a document with its correct digest and one with a different digest.
closure_check.expected: Only the exact matching contract is accepted.

findings.title: Lease digest uses record anchor instead of the specified transition field

closure_check.method: Compute a reference digest from the documented envelope and Approval.TransitionDigest, unit and accepted plan digest.
closure_check.expected: Reference and implementation agree byte for byte.

closure_check.method: Vary each documented identity field independently.
closure_check.expected: Every identity change alters the lease digest; identical input remains deterministic.

findings.title: Negative counters pass the lease ceiling check

closure_check.method: Run negative_counters separately for each signed counter and zero/below/equal ceiling controls.
closure_check.expected: Every negative input refuses; zero and valid below-ceiling inputs pass; equality refuses.

findings.title: Required document fields can be omitted or null, including a plan that obtains an active lease

closure_check.method: Run TestAuditAllUnitFieldsDeclared and TestAuditNullRetryBudget through the supplied overlay.
closure_check.expected: Missing/null retry budget refused; explicit zero accepted.

closure_check.method: Run TestAuditExplicitCheckArgv and TestAuditContractFieldsDeclared; add explicit [] positive controls.
closure_check.expected: Missing/null required arrays refused; valid empty argv/non-goals arrays accepted.

closure_check.method: Run TestAuditMissingRetryCanReachActiveLease.
closure_check.expected: The incomplete plan is refused before active lease derivation.

closure_check.method: Run corrected full go test, go vet, and race commands.
closure_check.expected: Existing stage, Gate B and Gate C behavior remains passing; accepted legacy approval bytes remain unchanged.

findings.title: A unit tag can hide a whole-run Grounding rewind from lease invalidation

closure_check.method: Run TestAuditorD12WholeRunRewindWithUnitID for empty, A and unrelated D, in normal and race modes.
closure_check.expected: Each case either refuses the invalid scope before append or returns a non-active A lease after an accepted Grounding rewind.

closure_check.method: Add the equivalent legal Release-and-closure -> Acceptance-criteria case; progress after a global rewind without issuing a new A approval; then issue a fresh legal A approval.
closure_check.expected: All old A generations remain void; only the new issuer can resume.

closure_check.method: Run existing and auditor dependency correction/route/plan rewind controls and unrelated correction control.
closure_check.expected: Direct/transitive dependents refuse; independent unit remains active for genuinely unit-scoped rewinds.

closure_check.method: Run full go test ./..., go vet ./... and go test -race ./..., then obtain a fresh isolated audit.
closure_check.expected: All checks pass and the independent auditor finds no remaining rewind bypass.

findings.title: Selected-route coherence is absent from the pure lease interface

closure_check.method: Keep contract, plan bytes and accepted_plan_digest fixed. Supply matching selected profile and approval as a positive control. Then vary profile identity, permission class, approval reference and unit independently.
closure_check.expected: Matching selection succeeds. Each mismatch and missing projection refuses before the lease is active.

closure_check.method: Use a selected bounded_write route under a read_only unit/contract, then restore read_only; include legal Independent validation -> Implementation authorization rework.
closure_check.expected: Broadening refuses. Matching read_only and legal rework succeed with the proper route binding.

closure_check.method: Rerun existing full test/vet/race and independent lease/rewind/legacy-byte controls.
closure_check.expected: All pass; no illegal issuer, scope widening or legacy serialization change.

findings.title: A lease stays active after a bound waiver invalidates its issuing approval

closure_check.method: Run the preserved waiver-overlay reproduction in normal and race modes.
closure_check.expected: All four subtests pass: bound withdrawal, expiration and withdrawal/regrant refuse; the unbound control remains active.

closure_check.method: Add separate controls for unrelated scope, a new legal issuer bound to the current waiver generation, multiple grants, and missing/malformed references to actually bound grants.
closure_check.expected: Unrelated changes preserve the lease. Only the fresh valid issuer can resume. Ambiguous bound provenance fails closed; no older generation revives.

closure_check.method: Rerun full test, vet, race, route/rewind/legacy-byte controls and obtain a fresh independent audit.
closure_check.expected: All regressions pass and the new invalidation test passes without relaxing the original contract.

findings.title: A new issuer can bind an inactive or replaced waiver grant and obtain a lease

closure_check.method: Run TestAuditRealApplyWaiverGeneration in normal and race modes.
closure_check.expected: withdrawn, expired, and old_after_regrant refuse at Apply or DeriveLease; current_after_regrant remains active.

closure_check.method: Run TestAuditWaiverAfterIssuer and TestAuditWaiverInvalidAtIssuer in normal and race modes.
closure_check.expected: Bound withdrawal/expiry/replacement never revive old issuers. Unbound and unrelated controls remain active. Current valid issuers pass. Missing, malformed, and duplicate references refuse.

closure_check.method: Run full go test ./..., go vet ./..., go test -race ./... with matched TMPDIR and GOTMPDIR.
closure_check.expected: All regressions pass; legacy approval bytes remain identical.

findings.title: Correction lease reuses a route approval invalidated by a bound waiver

closure_check.method: Run TestAuditorD12CurrentWaiversDoNotRestoreOldRoute with and without -race.
closure_check.expected: withdraw, expire and replace return a refusal before an active lease. fresh_route_control remains active.

closure_check.method: Run TestAuditorD12ReworkMustRetainValidRouteApproval and the direct issuer waiver, route mismatch, rewind, legacy-byte, full test/vet/race controls.
closure_check.expected: Bound route changes refuse. Live, unrelated, unbound and freshly reapproved route controls pass. Existing Gate B/C behavior remains passing.

findings.title: Correction issuer reuses a route approval invalidated by a plan or whole-run rewind

closure_check.method: Run the preserved TestAuditorD12ReworkAfterInvalidatedRoute and TestAuditorD12RealApplyInvalidatedRoute in normal and race modes.
closure_check.expected: Affected-unit and whole-run Planning rewind cases refuse. Unrelated-unit and fresh-route cases remain active.

closure_check.method: Run TestAuditorD12RealApplyChangedPlanRoute and add equivalent accepted criteria/route rewind cases with unit tags.
closure_check.expected: A changed plan route cannot use a pre-rewind approval; a new matching route approval restores eligibility.

closure_check.method: Run all original tests/vet/race, waiver-generation, ordinary legal correction, route mismatch, dependency, wall-time and legacy-byte controls; obtain a clean isolated follow-up audit.
closure_check.expected: All controls pass without waiving binding, independence, human approval or route constraints.
